title: docs: CONFIGURATION.md's taskSizing row and governor.md's size rubric say the distinct-file limit counts step affectedFiles, but submit_plan's size gate also counts newFiles (submitPlan.ts:427-432), so a plan sized by the docs can still be refused at submit
description:
Filed by the governor from a lane-2 lead in hunt #15 (task-928a468d, msg-492975dd), verified at tip f76c55f3.

PROBLEM
packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/submitPlan.ts:427-432 builds the size-gate input as `affectedFiles: [...step.affectedFiles, ...step.newFiles]`. Its comment says: "Count newFiles toward the distinct-file total too ... so the exemption can't be used to dodge the sizing cap". assessPlanSize (util/planSize.ts:88-109) then compares that union against warnDistinctFiles/maxDistinctFiles.
Two documents say only affectedFiles count:
- docs/CONFIGURATION.md, taskSizing row: "distinct files = union of step `affectedFiles`".
- docs/roles/governor.md:78, size rubric: ">10 distinct `affectedFiles`" and "6–10 distinct files".
An architect or governor who sizes a plan by the docs undercounts. A plan with 8 affectedFiles plus 3 newFiles is refused CONSTRAINT_VIOLATION at submit_plan, although the docs say it is inside the limit.

FIX DIRECTION
Docs only, no code change: say the distinct-file count is the union of each step's affectedFiles and newFiles.
- In CONFIGURATION.md, edit only that clause of the taskSizing row. Placement note: task-e67470ce (BACKLOG) may later edit the same table row's step limit, so keep the edit to the parenthetical.
- Make the same change in governor.md:78.
- Check docs/roles/architect.md:7 and docs/MCP_SERVER.md's submit_plan section for the same wording, and fix it where it appears.
Role docs ship through the generated packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts. Regenerate it in a snapshot outside the shared checkout (the prebuild generator, as earlier role-doc commits did, e.g. 93db1ce0), and carry the regenerated file in the same commit. Never run npm run build in the shared checkout (global rail). Edit docs/** with the seat's own editor, never a shell write.

GATE
`npm run lint` (role-doc linter) at the repo root, and packages/moe-daemon's src/util/initFiles.test.ts in the snapshot.
definitionOfDone: docs/CONFIGURATION.md's taskSizing row and docs/roles/governor.md's size rubric say the distinct-file count is the union of each step's affectedFiles and newFiles, matching submitPlan.ts:427-432. Any other doc found with the same wording (architect.md, the submit_plan section of MCP_SERVER.md) is fixed too.
packages/moe-daemon/src/generated/initFiles.ts is regenerated from the edited role doc and committed with it. src/util/initFiles.test.ts passes in a snapshot outside the shared checkout.
npm run lint passes at the repo root, and the diff touches no code.
